title.zh: VINNER | 感染控制、个人护理与工业擦拭
title.en: VINNER | Infection Control, Personal Care & Industrial Wiping

description.zh: VINNER 旗下 MEDIKEEP、CAREKEEP、INDUKEEP 为感染控制、个人护理和工业擦拭场景提供专业湿巾与擦拭解决方案。
description.en: VINNER brings MEDIKEEP, CAREKEEP, and INDUKEEP to infection control, personal care, and industrial wiping environments.

hero.alt: 洁净实验环境中的专业防护场景

body.zh:
从医疗感染控制到日常护理，
再到高强度工业擦拭，
VINNER 以克制、可靠、可追溯
的产品体系服务关键环境。
body.en: From infection control to personal care and high-duty industrial wiping, VINNER supports critical environments with disciplined, dependable, traceable product systems.

title.zh: 围绕不同污染风险与接触场景，建立清晰的擦拭产品架构。
title.en: A clear wiping architecture built around contamination risk and contact conditions.

lines.alt: 简洁白色护理包装与洁净产品细节

body.zh: 面向医院、诊所、实验室和公共卫生设施的感染控制擦拭产品。强调接触面清洁、材料兼容和稳定供应。
body.en: Wiping systems for hospitals, clinics, labs, and public health facilities, focused on clean contact surfaces, material compatibility, and dependable supply.

lines.alt: 浅色自然光下的个人护理与手部清洁场景

body.zh: 覆盖家庭、母婴、成人护理与外出便携场景。触感温和、使用直觉清晰，让日常护理更从容。
body.en: For home, maternal, adult-care, and on-the-go routines, with gentle touch, clear usage logic, and calmer daily care.

lines.alt: 工业生产环境中的洁净维护与设备作业

body.zh: 服务制造、设备维护、喷涂、电子与精密加工环境。为油污、粉尘、溶剂和高频作业提供耐用擦拭方案。
body.en: For manufacturing, maintenance, coating, electronics, and precision processing, with durable wiping performance for oil, dust, solvents, and repetitive tasks.

title.zh: 二十年湿巾研发与制造。
title.en: Twenty years in wipes R&D and manufacturing.

paragraphs.zh: 维尼健康（深圳）股份有限公司成立于 2004 年，2015 年成功挂牌新三板，是一家从事湿巾产品研发、生产、销售的专业制造商。
paragraphs.en: Vinner Health (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. was founded in 2004 and listed on the NEEQ in 2015. The company specializes in wet wipes R&D, manufacturing, and sales.

paragraphs.zh: 公司以专业化、精细化的研-产-销一体驱动，采用 ODM/OEM 和联合研发的模式，为国内外品牌客户提供差异化、高品质的湿巾产品与服务。
paragraphs.en: The company combines professional R&D, manufacturing, and sales capabilities, using ODM/OEM and joint-development models to serve domestic and international brands with differentiated, high-quality wipe products and services.

body.zh: 年湿巾研发与生产经验
body.en: years of wet wipes R&D and manufacturing experience

body.zh: 年医疗消毒湿巾生产经验
body.en: years of medical disinfectant wipes manufacturing experience

title.zh: 四条产品线，覆盖医疗、护理、工业与定制。
title.en: Four product lines across medical, care, industrial, and custom programs.

title.zh: 把湿巾做成可验证、可复用的系统。
title.en: Turning wipes into validated, repeatable systems.

body.zh: 配方、基材、包装和法规资料共同构成产品稳定性。VINNER 将研发投入、实验室验证和合作网络沉淀为客户可以复用的开发能力。
body.en: Formula, substrate, packaging, and regulatory documents all shape product stability. VINNER turns R&D investment, lab validation, and partner networks into reusable development capability for customers.

title.zh: 服务国内外品牌客户与渠道伙伴。
title.en: Serving brand customers and channel partners worldwide.
